correctness.rationale: The proof starts from the published identity \(dA_{j-1}/dt=d_j\int \eta E_j\,d\mu\) and the published exact derivative of \(f_j\). At the umbilic sphere, the standard variation \(\delta W=-\nabla^2u-\csc^2R\,uI\) gives the displayed second variations. Direct symbolic cancellation leaves \((k-\ell)d_{k+1}\cot^kR/n\) times the round-sphere Poincare form, while differentiating the matching-ball map supplies exactly the mean correction. The round-sphere spectrum then gives kernel degrees zero and one and the sharp degree-two gap. The \(k=0,\ell=-1\) specialization recovers the classical spherical isoperimetric second-variation form, providing an independent sign/normalization check.

value.rationale: The full spherical Alexandrov--Fenchel family was only completed in the lead 2026 source. The exact Hessian gives the first sharp local quadratic model of every pair at equality, identifies precisely the geometric degeneracies that any quantitative stability theorem must mod out, and supplies the sharp degree-two coercivity constant. The collapse of all index pairs to one Poincare form, up to an explicit scalar, is a structural fact useful for modulation and local stability rather than an arbitrary numerical slice.
